text:
[LGRA.7.2] One scaffolding keyword (`series`) introduces every
declaration. The body is one or more **observation lines**;
each line names what to compute (aggregations) and over what
window (time model). Every v1 aggregation is exact ([LSER.15.1]). Storage backings are
not author-visible — the compiler picks them per
[LSER.13.3] from the catalogue at
[LSER.18.1].
